Why reasoning-unit queries help

✓ 3 claims traced

Reasoning-unit queries can improve multi-hop retrieval because they replace one overloaded question with smaller queries that correspond to its intermediate information needs. A dense retriever can then search for each missing fact independently, rather than trying to match every relation at once. In your oracle experiment, that decomposition created substantial headroom: supporting-fact recall rose from 0.542 with sentence retrieval to 0.917 with ideal reasoning units.

✦ What this does—and does not—show
It shows better intermediate representations could unlock retrieval quality. It does not yet prove that an automatic generator can reliably create those representations.
